{{Top|leg}}
'''Bay seven''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Tahl]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Xanatos]] and [[Orykan Tamarik]] used the ship docked there as transport during the [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|First Mission to Telos]].
